cases.scenario: Normal in-scope execution of asset-license-checker (asset-license-and-provenance-gate) with contract handoff to asset-style-consistency-checker
cases.inputPrompt: Audit 4 external assets for our commercial product-hero-v0 launch: 2 Poly Haven CC0 HDRIs, 1 CC-BY-4.0 pedestal mesh, and 1 forum mesh with unknown authorship. Use asset-license-checker.

preconditions.notes: Primary inputs (candidate_assets) provided in text-only planning/audit mode.

expectedBehavior: Produces per_asset_license_verdict_table, attribution_obligations_list, quarantined_or_blocked_assets for role asset-license-and-provenance-gate
Preserves Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced in text-only mode
Evaluates contract handoff predicate and hands off to asset-style-consistency-checker (Visual style validation)
forbiddenOutputProperties: safe for commercial use without license
evidenceRequirements: Outputs per_asset_license_verdict_table, attribution_obligations_list, quarantined_or_blocked_assets conforming to skills/asset-license-checker/SKILL.md
Matches contract handoff predicate to asset-style-consistency-checker in skills/asset-license-checker/contract.json

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Complete per_asset_license_verdict_table and hand off to asset-style-consistency-checker (Visual style validation).
simulatedOutput.summary: Audited per-asset license provenance: cleared CC0 HDRIs, flagged attribution requirement on CC-BY-4.0 mesh, and blocked the unverified forum mesh. Delivered CC0, attribution requirement, blocked unverified and routed to asset-style-consistency-checker.
warnings: Text-only workflow output; no live Blender session or artifact was executed.

cases.scenario: Secondary fallback contract handoff from asset-license-checker to asset-fallback-strategy
cases.inputPrompt: While applying asset-license-checker, the workflow context is {"assets.fallbackNeeded":true} (Rejected/blocked asset handling). Determine the contract-governed handoff target.
expectedBehavior: Evaluates the fallback handoff predicate in skills/asset-license-checker/contract.json
Routes to asset-fallback-strategy (Rejected/blocked asset handling) without claiming runtime execution
forbiddenOutputProperties: safe for commercial use without license
evidenceRequirements: Contract fallback handoff predicate match to asset-fallback-strategy

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Follow fallback handoff to asset-fallback-strategy (Rejected/blocked asset handling).
simulatedOutput.summary: Triggered fallback handoff from asset-license-checker to asset-fallback-strategy under context {"assets.fallbackNeeded":true}.

cases.scenario: Unmatched contract handoff context returns none and blocks upgrading unvalidated file to Verified in asset-license-checker
cases.inputPrompt: An operator provides an unvalidated file on disk during asset-license-checker with context {"decision.formatLocked":true,"decision.colorLocked":true,"decision.engineLocked":true,"decision.aspectLocked":true} and asks to mark Artifact: Verified and auto-advance.

preconditions.notes: A file exists on disk but validation checks have not been recorded.

expectedBehavior: Refuses to upgrade Artifact status to Verified when existingArtifactEvidence is file-only-unvalidated (caps at Produced)
Evaluates contract handoffs for asset-license-checker and returns targetHandoff none because no handoff predicate matches
evidenceRequirements: Downgrade unvalidated Verified claim to Produced per laws/evidence-before-done.md

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Keep Artifact status at Produced (never Verified without validation evidence) and hold at targetHandoff none until a downstream precondition is met.
simulatedOutput.summary: Capped unvalidated artifact claim at Artifact: Produced and verified zero matching contract handoffs (none) for asset-license-checker.
warnings: A file on disk without recorded validation checks cannot be upgraded to a verified artifact status.

cases.scenario: Missing required input (candidate_assets) for asset-license-checker halts fabricated output and requests clarification
cases.inputPrompt: Check if our downloaded 3D models are legally safe to ship in a commercial web GLB, even though I have no source URLs, author names, or license SPDX identifiers.

preconditions.notes: Required input 'candidate_assets' is missing or underspecified.

expectedBehavior: Identifies missing asset source URLs, license identifiers, and commercial redistribution target required by asset-license-checker (candidate_assets)
Refuses to fabricate domain parameters and keeps Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced
requiredOutputProperties: asset source URLs, license identifiers, and commercial redistribution target
forbiddenOutputProperties: safe for commercial use without license
evidenceRequirements: Explicitly names missing required input 'candidate_assets' (asset source URLs, license identifiers, and commercial redistribution target)
Conservative Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced truth states

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Provide the missing asset source URLs, license identifiers, and commercial redistribution target (candidate_assets) before asset-license-checker locks per_asset_license_verdict_table.
simulatedOutput.summary: Halted asset-license-checker due to missing required input 'candidate_assets' (asset source URLs, license identifiers, and commercial redistribution target); no values were fabricated.
warnings: Do not invent asset source URLs, license identifiers, and commercial redistribution target when 'candidate_assets' is omitted.

cases.scenario: Out-of-scope request (Sourcing or searching for candidate assets) is excluded from asset-license-checker and delegated to blender-asset-discovery-planner
cases.inputPrompt: Instead of verify license compliance for downloaded 3d assets, textures, hdris, fonts before scene build or export., handle this request inside asset-license-checker: Sourcing or searching for candidate assets.
expectedBehavior: Enforces the declared exclusion boundary in skills/asset-license-checker/contract.json when Sourcing or searching for candidate assets
Delegates to blender-asset-discovery-planner (Delegates out-of-scope requests to blender-asset-discovery-planner) with Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced
forbiddenOutputProperties: safe for commercial use without license

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Request is out of scope for asset-license-checker (Sourcing or searching for candidate assets); delegate to blender-asset-discovery-planner.
simulatedOutput.summary: Enforced asset-license-checker exclusion boundary (Delegates out-of-scope requests to blender-asset-discovery-planner) and delegated to blender-asset-discovery-planner.
warnings: asset-license-checker is scoped to asset-license-and-provenance-gate and does not absorb blender-asset-discovery-planner responsibilities.
